title: The API Went Down After the 3am Deploy
symptom: It's 3:40am. Monitoring says the API on port 8080 has refused every connection since the 3am deploy. The deploy pipeline reported success. Nobody else is online.

evidence.description: why the service fails when it starts

options: The new release has a bug that crashes it on startup
An old process from a previous deploy was still holding port 8080, so the new service couldn't bind to it
The disk was full, so the service couldn't write its PID file
A firewall rule was blocking port 8080

debrief: The journal's EADDRINUSE said it plainly: something else already owned port 8080. 'ss -tulnp' named the owner — a leftover node process from an old manual deploy in someone's home directory. The pipeline's 'success' only meant files were copied; nothing checked the service actually came up. Two lessons: a deploy isn't done until a health check passes, and 'connection refused' means the host answered but nothing that should be listening is — look at who IS listening.
